about: Values that must never reach the document, each in a shape that once did: a token in a dependency URL, credentials on line 1 of requirements.txt, a password holding # and /, a key in a query string, an upper-case host.
nearMisses: git+https://<token>@... declares no named package and no version
a URL version is not compared, so it is never shown
--extra-index-url carries credentials and is not quoted
redis://:<pw>#x@host and postgres://u:ab/<pw>@host keep the host only
fetch(/api/y?apiKey=...) is cited up to its query
https://API.Corp.io is cited as spelled on the line
a token pasted as a .env key is not read
